evidence_class: Native firmware Load and serial MIDI, read-only pitch bus traces and PCM measurements; not physical/packaged acceptance
prerequisites: User-supplied ROM/OS and hash-checked ROBOLOOP; built native executable; fresh private absolute state path; permitted local sockets; headless unthrottled

fixture.changes: Partial copies/coarse tuning and patch key map only; all samples/PCM unchanged

result.limits: Named octave changes through partial/key mapping and overlapping notes; no continuous bend/glide, click-free guarantee, arbitrary pitch ratios or new hardware interpolation parity

acceptance: 21 isolated mode/octave combinations; exact expected pitch words; repeating recurrence correlation >0.99; one-shot durations within8 frames of expected; one-second silent tails;42 overlapping note transitions finite/bounded and released
limitations: No continuous bend/glide qualification beyond existing separate controller evidence
No claim of click-free transitions or physical interpolation fidelity outside measured domains
Octave points only; not arbitrary pitch ratios, other native sample clocks or all firmware parameter combinations
At double speed odd-length loops use a two-cycle integral recurrence; pitch-register observations independently establish speed

backend_regressions.scope: Full tests/; private harness/snapshot/temp/cache and permitted local sockets
